glossary.definition: (A) "Adult" means an individual who is not a minor child.
glossary.source_title: Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Assistance group" means a group of individuals treated as a unit for purposes of determining eligibility for and the amount of assistance provided under Ohio works first.
glossary.source_title: Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Custodian" means an individual who has legal custody, as defined in section 2151.011 of the Revised Code, of a minor child or comparable status over a minor child created by a court of competent jurisdiction in another state.
glossary.source_title: Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.
Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Guardian" means an individual that is granted authority by a probate court pursuant to Chapter 2111. of the Revised Code, or a court of competent jurisdiction in another state, to exercise parental rights over a minor child to the extent provided in the court's order and subject to residual parental rights of the minor child's parents.
glossary.source_title: Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "LEAP program" means the learning, earning, and parenting program conducted under section 5107.30 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.
Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.
Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Ohio works first" means the program established by this chapter known as temporary assistance for needy families in Title IV-A.
glossary.source_title: Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Payment standard" means the amount specified in rules adopted under section 5107.05 of the Revised Code that is the maximum amount of cash assistance an assistance group may receive under Ohio works first from state and federal funds.
glossary.source_title: Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.
Section 5107.02 - Ohio works first program definitions.

glossary.definition:
(L) "Title IV-A" or "Title IV-D" means Title IV-A or Title IV-D of the "Social Security Act," 49 Stat. 620 (1935), 42 U.S.C. 301, as amended.
